title: 第17章 八百就八百
content_zh:
“钱到账了！”

    谷川和沃伦击掌，又给他塞了一张钞票。

    “这次的汉堡也买可乐。”谷川笑着说道。

    “剩下的还是我的小费吗？”沃伦问道。

    “当然。”谷川说道：“不过你帮我联系一下狮门的人，我想买他们一部电影的翻拍权。”

    “你也太为难我了。”沃伦看了看手上的钞票，又看了看谷川。

    果然，拿这个家伙的钱太难了。

    他看着谷川问道：“你凭什么认为我能联系上狮门的人？”

    他只是一个经营野鸡奖的小混混而已，怎么可能认识狮门的人。

    “而且你有钱吗？”沃伦警惕的看着谷川。

    他甚至担心，谷川买版权，还朝他借钱。

    沃伦捂着口袋说道：“我告诉你，我刚交了一个女朋友，现在可没有钱借给你。”

    “我向你借过钱吗？你这么诬陷我。”谷川不满的看着沃伦。

    “没有。”沃伦摇了摇头。

    你都是直接要的，从来没还过。

    沃伦拍了拍自己的脑袋。

    既然这个家伙从来不还钱，那我怎么还一直借钱给他呢？

    谷川勾搭着沃伦的肩膀说道：“我记得你爸曾经是个导演，拍过的一部电影，是狮门发行的。”

    “那都很多年前的事情了。”沃伦说道。

    那都是十年前的事情了。

    他爸早就因为一部电影血亏，彻底告别电影圈了。

    谷川说道：“我只是想向狮门买中国大陆的翻拍权而已，还是买《女巫布莱克》的。”

    “你是要给他们白送钱吗？”沃伦奇怪的说道。

    中国大陆的翻拍权？

    好莱坞可能就没指望过，能卖出这种版权，谷川去找他们，他们可能会很高兴有人给他们送钱。

    “对，就是白送钱。”谷川说道。

    反正又不是花他的钱。

    “那我去问问老头吧。”沃伦说道。

    如果还有联系方式的话，有人去送钱，他们应该有兴趣见一见。

    ……

    午后的阳光有些刺眼。

    狮门的制片人汤姆，正瘫坐在办公桌后，百无聊赖地转着手中的钢笔。
content_en:
"The money has arrived!"

    Tanichuan high-fived Warren and slipped him another bill.

    "I'll also buy Coke for the burger this time," Tanigawa said with a smile.

    "Is the rest still my tip?" Warren asked.

    "Of course." Tanichuan said: "But please help me contact people at Lions Gate. I want to buy the remake rights of one of their movies."

    "You're making things too difficult for me." Warren looked at the bills in his hand and then at Tanichuan.

    Sure enough, it was too difficult to get this guy's money.

    He looked at Tanichuan and asked, "Why do you think I can contact someone from Lions Gate?"

    He is just a little gangster who runs Pheasant Awards. How could he know anyone from Lions Gate?

    "And do you have money?" Warren looked at Tanichuan warily.

    He was even worried that Tanichuan would buy the copyright and borrow money from him.

    Warren held his pocket and said, "I'm telling you, I just got a girlfriend, and I don't have any money to lend you now."

    "Have I ever borrowed money from you? You framed me like this." Tanichuan looked at Warren dissatisfied.

    "No." Warren shook his head.

    You asked for it directly and never paid it back.

    Warren patted his head.

    Since this guy never pays me back, why do I keep lending him money?

    Tanigawa put his arm around Warren's shoulders and said, "I remember your dad used to be a director, and he made a movie that was released by Lionsgate."

    "That was all those years ago," Warren said.

    That was ten years ago.

    His father had already lost a lot of money due to one movie and had completely said goodbye to the film industry.

    Tanigawa said: "I just want to buy the remake rights in mainland China from Lions Gate, and I will buy "Black Witch"."

    "Are you going to give them free money?" Warren said strangely.

    Remake rights in mainland China?

    Hollywood may not have expected to be able to sell this kind of copyright. Tanigawa went to them, and they may be very happy that someone would give them money.

    "Yes, it's just free money." Tanichuan said.

    It’s not like he’s spending his money anyway.

    "Then let me ask the old man." Warren said.

    If there is still contact information for someone to send money to, they should be interested in meeting.

    …

    The afternoon sun was a bit harsh.

    Lionsgate producer Tom was sitting slumped behind his desk, spinning the pen in his hand out of boredom.
